plugins.name: Failovarr
plugins.description: Consolidate N IPTV providers into unified channels with cross-provider failover, by deterministic normalized-name matching (no fuzzy). One channel per normalized name, both providers' streams stacked as failover, so a channel enabled on either provider is never lost. Keeps provider category groups; locals key on callsign; adult split; deterministic EPG across all sources with free logos. Optional PPV / live-event failover. In-place reconcile (never wipe-and-rebuild), safe to run daily.
plugins.author: Roy Dufek
